limits: Evidence only; this directory does not sign MDD-026 or admit a profile.
Small synthetic fixtures; no private inputs, full HostLab corpus, SQL transport or performance qualification.
The same immutable DEX is presented twice so two scope occurrences carry identical content_id and file_id 0/1; the content projection drops file_id so the two occurrences' rows are byte-identical.
Per-column multiplicity picks the projection that includes the column and exercises the most exact duplicate rows; the per-occurrence key column uses a key-drop projection when one exists.
classes.file_id and annotation_elements.file_id have no projection with an exact duplicate row in the available fixtures; they are recorded as partial with duplicate_collapse not_applicable.
